sentences.en: The repertoire of the puppet theater is rich and interesting.
sentences.zh: 木偶剧院的节目丰富有趣。

sentences.en: I want to keep bulking up my repertoire.
sentences.zh: 我想不断充实我的表演库。

sentences.en: It's important for every musician to ensure there is variety in their repertoire.
sentences.zh: 对于每位音乐家来说，确保曲目的多样性是很重要的。
